agreements: The organism is recurrent rather than a one-way dream-LoRA-think pipeline.
Semantic graph growth and LoRA write-realization fanout are distinct operations.
Thinker feedback is selection-only and never evidence.
v0.3-R is a calibration tier, not the headline scale or action benchmark.
CPU contracts, text controls, independent reviews, and explicit human scope precede GPU science.

disagreements.issue: How one semantic memory receives independent reinforcement without duplicated graph nodes.

positions.position: One semantic conclusion has exactly one derivation.
One semantic conclusion has one creation derivation and may have later novel support derivations.

resolution.rationale: Independent reinforcement is a required dream behavior and must be auditable separately from node count.
resolution.selected_position: One creation derivation plus later unique-evidence reinforcement derivations.
resolution.required_change: Enforce unique evidence identities, append-only support events, and independent-support metrics without node duplication.

disagreements.issue: Whether v0.3-R can carry the final paper claim.

positions.position: Use v0.3-R to close the recurrent organism interface.
Use v0.3-R only as calibration because its lifetime is small and retrieval is a strong baseline.

resolution.rationale: The interface result is useful, but context-scale and action claims require different rungs.
resolution.selected_position: Calibration only, followed by long-life and Action World tiers.
resolution.required_change: Preserve the label in docs, results, and review prompts; include raw context and iterative retrieval controls.

disagreements.issue: What thinker output a later dream may consume.

positions.position: Consume typed unresolved dependencies and desired local relations as an agenda.
Exclude answer, operation, rationale, confidence, and scorer truth from evidentiary or write channels.

resolution.rationale: Selection can create useful recurrence without self-approval only if later durable claims are independently re-derived.
resolution.selected_position: Mechanical allowlist projection to a non-evidentiary agenda.
resolution.required_change: Reject feedback citations, direct feedback realizations, hidden answers, and unchecked memory promotion.

disagreements.issue: How to distinguish recurrence from extra inference compute.

positions.position: Run the useful agenda-conditioned return edge.
Give no-feedback and shuffled-feedback arms the same intermediate thinker and maximum dream budget.

resolution.rationale: Matched calls and actual-token reporting are required for causal attribution.
resolution.selected_position: Equal maximum budgets, identical pre-feedback history, and shuffled-agenda control.
resolution.required_change: Freeze the schedule and report actual compute separately from the matched ceiling.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The contract must distinguish semantic identity from multiple evidence paths.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Implement novel reinforcement derivations and independent support metrics.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The feedback path otherwise becomes a hidden answer write.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Make agendas selection-only and prohibit them as premises or realization sources.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The small game closes interfaces but cannot establish scaling.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep v0.3-R non-headline and schedule long-life/action tiers.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Recurrent benefit must not reduce to extra calls.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Match maximum budgets and include shuffled feedback.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Independent support is part of the intended dream graph.
